## About
Anytime Truck and Trailer Repair is a commercial vehicle shop on Marigold Dr in Dallas, TX. We keep our own fleet in shape in this workshop, and we open it up to outside customers too.
The workshop has a hall for maintenance and repairs of trucks and trailers. We handle safety inspections, general inspections, exhaust emission tests and hydraulic repairs. We keep our own tire warehouse with the most common tire dimensions and fix minor tread damage right in the shop.
We carry Freightliner, Volvo and other original parts and accessories, and we procure every available spare part. Rated 4.8 on Google from 202 reviews.

## Services
- Auto engine diagnostic: Find the problem before fixing it.
- Steering and suspension: Steering and suspension work for trucks.
- Air and cabin filter replacement: Air and cabin filters swapped out.
- Oil change: Routine oil changes for your truck.
- Battery: Battery replacement. One reviewer had their batteries replaced here.
- Transmission: Transmission repair work. One reviewer had transmission work done here.
- Tires: Tires for trucks and trailers. Ask us about tires, rims or complete wheels.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on trailers too?
A: Yes. Our workshop handles maintenance and repairs of both trucks and trailers, including trailer bodies.

Q: Do you do inspections?
A: Yes. We do safety inspections, general inspections and exhaust emission tests, plus hydraulic repairs.

Q: Can you get the part I need?
A: We carry Freightliner, Volvo and other original parts and accessories, and we procure every available spare part.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
